data.name: Baseem
data.gender_notes: Baseem is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: From the Arabic root 'B-S-M', meaning 'to open the eyes'. In Islamic history, this name is given to those who have gained spiritual insight and wisdom. The name Baseem carries the meaning “Awakening, Enlightenment” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Baseem usually hope their child will grow to embody awakening, enlightenment and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbolizes spiritual awakening and enlightenment in the journey towards self-improvement and closeness to Allah.
data.etymology: Baseem belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Awakening, Enlightenment.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Baseem total 9, giving a life-path number of 9. Number 9 is linked with Mars and with the qualities of compassion, idealism and generosity.
